Caption:
Let us share some more details about our most recently launched location📍The Orchard.

The site is a hybrid between an on-grid and off-grid location, as it is connected to the power grid, but not to the water grid. Nevertheless, it’s mainly powered by green energy through the solar panels, but in winter it can be heated via heating panels in addition to the wood stove.

The cabin is placed between numerous rows of old fruit trees that were planted in the 1960s. You can find up to 24 different varieties of apples on site, many of which you won't get in any supermarket. You also share the meadow with a small flock of sheep and Krümel, the horse.

As for the remoteness of this location,📍The Orchard is situated on a spacious private property, just a short walk to a tiny village. 

You can find more details about all our locations in our story highlights.
